name: shipinhao-script
description: Write a script for WeChat Channels (视频号): a short vertical video or a livestream outline built for sharing among friends and groups, with a first-three-seconds hook, plain spoken language, a title with topics, and a compliant route to follow, add or buy inside the WeChat ecosystem. Use when asked 写视频号脚本, 视频号文案, 视频号直播脚本, 视频号怎么起标题, 视频号引流到企业微信, or write a WeChat Channels video script. Distinct from douyin-script (interest-based feed) and wechat-article.
